premises.text: Worldwide bicycle theft is large-scale and costly
premises.evidence_span: over 5.7 billion euros of stolen bicycles every year

premises.text: Smart lock must combine alarm, security, GPS, and keyless access because prior products split these
premises.evidence_span: what does a truly smart lock have to have

premises.text: Advanced onboard sensors detect cutting, drilling, impact, thermal attack, and cable breach
premises.evidence_span: if someone tries to use a blowtorch or a cold spray on Lockheed, a temperature sensor will be able to detect this

premises.text: GPS tracking plus app notifications locate and alert on theft attempts
premises.evidence_span: we have a tracker, a GPS tracker that no other bicycle lock has

premises.text: App also enables sharing bikes and renting locks for connected mobility
premises.evidence_span: I can offer my bike to rent. To anyone

premises.text: Connected mobility scales with devices alone, not city infrastructure
premises.evidence_span: We don't need connected infrastructure. We just need simple devices

value.text: A truly smart bicycle lock people can trust and share
value.evidence_span: make a truly smart lock that we could use

causal_links.evidence_span: Bicycle theft is a huge problem worldwide
tamper detected your bike might be a risk
share bikes easily with anyone that we want

notes: Requirements list kept as one premise (P2) bundling must-have attributes of the same lock.
